( _de facto_; 2022–present) | **al-Qaeda**[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al-Qaeda#cite_note-64) is a [pan-Islamist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pan-Islamist) militant organization led by [Sunni](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sunni_Islam) [Islamist](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Islamism) [jihadists](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jihadists) who self-identify as a vanguard spearheading a global [Islamist revolution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Revolutionary_Islamism) to unite the [Muslim world](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muslim_world) under a supra-national Islamic [caliphate](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Caliphate). ## References 20. Archived from [the original](https://aissonline.org/en/main-features/7) on June 19, 2023. ["The Sunni-Shia Divide"](https://web.archive.org/web/20230610093711/https://www.cfr.org/article/sunni-shia-divide). _Council on Foreign Relations_.
